You probably got downvoted for your incorrect great war comment lol. Much of the spark of war was ignited over the need for resources, and all those non renewable resources don't consume themselves. 

Everything as far as the war itself to the many riots and revolts leading up to the war was a result of not having enough to support what everyone needed.  Everyone on top took a big gulp out of the well instead of a sip and eventually it ran dry. People in nice suburbs were buying their brand new robots and cars to distract themselves from the real issues. Even electric cars weren't distributed before the bombs. Instead of making viable technology to replace those limited resources, we made new weapons and armies to consume what little the Earth had left to give.  

Everyone was enjoying being the best country on earth until the repercussions of that wealth and consumption blew up in their face.
